scope: Current-authority-bound successor to the 09:17:06Z effect-authority bridge. Revalidates the material donor claims against the pinned Frankenstein source, preserves runtime reachability as unknown, and rebinds the evidence envelope to canonical main 5a953ebf824bbdc17091a638eb2b4a376aa8567e without minting runtime/model/training credit.

atoms.what_it_does: The donor explicitly states and implements ordinary EffectGate as nonblocking bookkeeping: PreToolUse emits no deny/block decision and tools proceed even when the bookkeeping check rejects or fails.
atoms.failure_mode: Calling the donor mechanism EffectGate can falsely imply containment authority that the executable path does not have.
open_questions: Recover exact host-global blocking predecessor composition/order or preserve it as historical unavailable provenance.

atoms.what_it_does: PreToolUse stores one effect_id in active_turns keyed by session_id and PostToolUse later reads the current session slot to locate the effect row; the donor therefore lacks immutable per-call correlation in this path.
atoms.failure_mode: If same-session mutating calls interleave, a later PreToolUse can overwrite the pointer before an earlier PostToolUse consumes it.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Structural race risk only; runtime occurrence is unproven until an overlapping-call trace is observed.
known_counterevidence: Counterhypothesis: the installed scheduler may serialize all relevant same-session PreToolUse/tool/PostToolUse triplets.
open_questions: Execute an authorized overlapping-call falsifier and bind tool_use_id -> effect_id -> posttool receipt before runtime causal credit.

atoms.what_it_does: PostToolUse source constructs bounded tool-result evidence by hashing resulting file bytes or Bash stdout/stderr and recording exit status; this is receipt-construction code, not itself a runtime receipt and not arbitrary world-effect verification.
atoms.failure_mode: Source semantics or successful tool return can be over-promoted to observed world-effect verification.
open_questions: Define effect-class-specific WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION and first-class UNKNOWN outcomes.

atoms.what_it_does: The effect proof predicate rejects only the exact legacy lowercase status 'fehler'; current non-success states are otherwise returned as ok and reconcile maps ok proof to stand='fertig'.
atoms.failure_mode: FEHLGESCHLAGEN, ABGELEHNT, WIEDERHOLUNG, UNGEPRUEFT or unknown states can structurally satisfy completion evidence.
open_questions: Replace with an explicit typed success allowlist and adversarial regressions for every non-success/unknown state.

atoms.what_it_does: A textual test:<exit_code>:<description> proof is accepted whenever exit_code equals '0' with no immutable runner, command, source, environment, output or invocation binding.
atoms.failure_mode: A forged or transplanted text claim can satisfy completion without observed execution identity.
open_questions: Bind completion to structured immutable execution receipts and reject transplanted/source-drift/invocation-drift evidence.

hypotheses: Using call-scoped tool_use_id or an equivalent immutable invocation identifier as the primary EffectDecision/receipt correlation key removes the structural session-pointer ambiguity without requiring serialized tool execution.
counterhypotheses: The exact installed scheduler may serialize all relevant same-session mutating calls, making the current session pointer safe in practice despite structural ambiguity.
contradictions: Donor naming/documentation calls the section EffectGate while the same source explicitly says it never blocks ordinary tools.
Completion documentation describes mechanically verified proof while the executable effect-status predicate remains a permissive legacy check and textual test:0 remains unbound.

The superseded 09:17:06Z packet was correctly bound to main 92c3b67 at creation time but became stale when canonical main advanced to 5a953eb; source findings remain valid while current-authority admission requires this successor envelope.
critical_unknowns: Exact host-global blocking predecessor source/config/order and whether it is present in the intended Frankenstein-2.0 donor baseline.
Effect-class-specific world verification semantics, especially unknown outcome after transport/session ambiguity.
